apps.name: Luma
apps.subtitle: Recovery, running, HYROX and fuelling from your WHOOP.
apps.localizedDescription: Luma reads a WHOOP strap you own directly over Bluetooth and turns it into recovery, sleep and strain each morning, GPS running with splits and spoken cues, HYROX race mode and readiness, a food and supplement log, and a coach. Your data stays on the phone; the coach runs on your own Anthropic key and reads only what you let it. A personal, non-commercial build on open-source foundations, credited in the app's About screen; not affiliated with WHOOP or HYROX.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 16. A companion, a new look, and twelve new reads of your data. Glim: a small companion on Today and as a new Lock Screen and Home Screen widget (add "Companion"). It is charged, steady or drained with your recovery, asleep in your usual night, thirsty when water is behind, in session when you train, and it celebrates a new best. Its build follows your own strength levels, part by part. Tap it for a wave. Open it to see why it looks the way it does. New type: tall, narrow titles and figures, and text that follows your iPhone's text size. Motion: a tile opens into its screen, muscles fill in, rows shimmer while photos are read, a banner for a new best, ticks that draw themselves, and a heart that beats at your real rate (and is still when there is no live reading). New analysis: supplement trials (blocks on and off, a fair answer); how much and how late (caffeine, alcohol, last meal, bedtime against the next morning, with your own caffeine cut-off); food against the work, day by day; a weight log with what you really burn; a kept weekly review; what goes with your stronger weeks; one model of what moves your recovery, with tomorrow's likely score; each lift's history and stalled lifts; your own sweat rate; an offer to ease off after two low mornings. Log without opening Luma: a water button on the Fuel widget, and "Log water in Luma" for Siri. Reminders, all off until you switch them on: Settings, Reminders.
